summary: Master Microsoft Excel tailored for agriculture professionals. Boost your data management skills and optimize your farming practices with our expert course.
lede: Farm Excel training helps agricultural professionals organize field, livestock, inventory, and financial records into useful operating reports. Designed for people who collect, check, calculate, or report farm data, it covers structured Tables and validation, SUMIFS and XLOOKUP calculations, and PivotTables for summarizing performance. Learners also practice cleaning and combining records with Power Query and presenting results in charts and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, calculate, verify, or report agricultural operating data. It supports foundation-level users who want to progress toward intermediate agricultural Excel analysis through guided practice.
modules: Microsoft Excel for Agriculture Professionals Foundations
Microsoft Excel for Agriculture Professionals Data Quality
XLOOKUP and SUMIFS for Agricultural Analysis
Power Query for Farm Data Automation
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course expects basic computer literacy and familiarity with agricultural records such as production, inventory, input, sales, or cost data. Prior experience entering information into Microsoft Excel is helpful but not essential. Completion requires spreadsheet formulas and menu-based configuration rather than coding or programming. You should bring a laptop with a supported desktop edition of Microsoft Excel and Power Query available. Training datasets are provided, and advanced features such as Solver, Power Query, Analyze Data, and Copilot receive operational or conceptual treatment according to licence availability.
